profile: Security engineer with a DevSecOps core: penetration testing, shift-left security, and pipeline enforcement at enterprise scale. I build the automated gates that catch risk before it ships, not after. Co-presented at Black Hat Asia 2020.

experience.title: Security Engineer, DevSecOps
experience.summary: Own security enforcement across the delivery pipeline for an enterprise engineering estate.
points: Engineered a merge-request security-gate enforcement layer on GitLab Premium, which ships no native external status checks, to block risky changes before they merge across thousands of active, non-standardized repositories.
Enforce automated Secret detection and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) in CI/CD today, with Static Application Security Testing (SAST) coverage rolling out next.
Build and maintain multiple security-tool integrations across the pipeline, tying detection, triage, and enforcement together through automated workflow orchestration.
Champion shift-left practices so vulnerabilities surface early in the lifecycle, where they are cheapest to fix and least disruptive to ship.

experience.title: Cyber Security Consultant
experience.summary: Offensive security across client web apps, networks, and infrastructure.
points: Performed comprehensive penetration tests on web applications, networks, and infrastructure to identify and report exploitable vulnerabilities.
Simulated real-world attacks, delivered actionable remediation guidance, and worked alongside engineering teams to strengthen their security posture.
